notes.title: 💀 SKIBIDI: ESCAPE FROM TOILETS — 70% OFF for the bravest TV MANs!
notes.content:
Thank you for your amazing support, TV MANs!
You inspire us to keep going. 

To celebrate, enjoy a 70% discount on SKIBIDI: ESCAPE FROM TOILETS! Gather your friends and face the terrifying SKIBIDI in this co-op horror experience for 1–4 players. 

It's a limited-time offer — escape while you still can! 👻

notes.title: Fixed player bar status when restarting a level.
notes.content:
Restarting a level will now not cause players to appear twice in the status bar.

If there are any issues, post in the community, I'll fix everything!

notes.title: Fixed phantom station loading issues at the subway level.
notes.content:
The subway is safer!

The phantom problem when loading stations has been defeated.

Thank you)

notes.content:
Phantom problem found and defeated!
100% loading on levels!

Write your ideas suggestions for the next updates)

notes.title: THE CRAZY LEADERS OF THE SKIBIDI ARENA!
notes.content:
This surprised even the developer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683332/8427e472bff1201b97aa5e81c6567e9ac9c7bbee.png[/img]

Survive 16 waves on an island filled with dangerous SKIBIDI!
Together, the two agents were able to flush 141 toilets!

These are real agents!

How many waves can you survive?
We're waiting for you on the SKIBIDI ARENA leaderboard!

The next update is already being prepared.
More new Skibidi, new locations, new abilities!

notes.title: SKIBIDI ARENA - MAJOR UPDATE AND DISCOUNT!
notes.content:
( One developer - there may be problems - all will be fixed )

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44683332/6b21426af5d2da9d96df8cedc49615c16c068de3.png[/img]

The agents came across a mysterious island. Fuel was running low and they had to go ashore. In the depths of the island they found a mysterious artifact. It gave off a soft glow and vibrated pleasantly. Mesmerized by the tantalizing artifact, the agents didn't notice they were surrounded by SKIBIDI. Teleportation doesn't work, they'll have to fight. Who knows if they can win.

The next update is already in the works.
More new Skibidi, new locations, new abilities!
